interpretation.threshold_policy: Measurement validity is gated; no predeclared zero-leakage threshold is used.
interpretation.velocity: Public velocity readback was sampled as magnitude.
interpretation.internal_representation: Not established by this probe; no claim of retained convex geometry or explicit voxel mask.

decision.classification: Collision ONでもOFFと同程度に上側へ到達する
decision.position_shift_response: 0.5-cell and 1-cell aggregate values were identical; no monotonic occlusion response was observed.
decision.visual_classification: OFF and aligned-ON captures both show the vertical volume continuing through and above the opaque Box; numeric and rendered evidence agree.
decision.phase6dr_current_explanation: The leading explanation is real Flow-field non-occlusion under the current public PhysX/Flow integration, not a ray-march-only illusion. The missing ingestion/constraint boundary is not identified.
decision.cylinder_reason: The required axis-aligned static Box did not establish occlusion, so Cylinder and dynamic-transform tests were not started.
